carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Pacific Coastal Airlines cabin baggage size limit: 55 x 40 x 20 cm.

weight_economy.notes: Pacific Coastal Airlines Economy Class carry-on weight limit.

weight_business_first.notes: Pacific Coastal Airlines Premium / Business Class carry-on weight limit.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Pre-paid fees apply up to 24 hours before departure; check-in fees apply when you pay within 24 hours of departure, online or at the airport.

size_weight.value: A checked bag is one item up to 50 pounds (23 kilograms) and 62 inches (158 cm) in linear dimensions, wheels and handles included. Single bags over 70lbs are not accepted; a maximum of three checked bags per passenger.

fees_by_fare.value: Fees including GST: Basic and Bravo fares pay for the 1st bag (Pre-Paid $36.75, Check-In $47.25); Classic includes the 1st bag and the 2nd costs Pre-Paid $57.75 / Check-In $68.25; Encore includes 2 bags. A 3rd bag or an oversized/overweight bag costs Pre-Paid $105 / Check-In $115.50 on every fare.

military.value: Canadian Military personnel (former or current) can check two bags, up to 50lbs and/or 62” linear dimensions each, at no charge with valid military ID; not extended to family members.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: For Basic fares, checking in late or making any change results in a no-show and forfeiture of the segment.

basic_fare.notes: The captured fare page lost its fare-name headings, so which fare this block describes cannot be confirmed from the capture. Re-capture before publishing.

24_hour_refund.value: Reservations made and cancelled within 24 hours of original purchase get a full refund, as long as you cancel at least 2 hours before departure, by calling 1.800.663.2872.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Payload limits mean checked baggage cannot always travel on the same flight.

bag_drop_cutoff.value: Drop checked bags at the check-in counter 60 minutes before departure (recommended); bags dropped 40 minutes or less before departure are not accepted.

phone_home_market.notes: Pacific Coastal's reservations and call centre number on its fare terms page.
